set.body: EyeLinkAscStreamingJvmSuite 'two hundred thousand lines stream without downstream materialization' timed out at 30 s during a root test run with two other sbt JVMs active (2026-09-17), and passed 6/6 in isolation. The property it protects is no downstream materialisation, not throughput; either assert memory/materialisation directly with a smaller input or raise the timeout and mark it as a performance guard so CI load cannot flake it.
set.title: EyeLink streaming test has a load-sensitive 30 s timeout
